passages.text: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke these words to His disciples.
Jesus then lifted His eyes to heaven.
Jesus prayed to God the Father.
Jesus said, “Father, the hour has come.
Glorify Your Son.
Then the Son will glorify You.”
passages.original: Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν Πάτερ ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα δόξασόν σου τὸν Υἱόν ἵνα ὁ Υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ

passages.text: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
passages.sermon:
God the Father gave Jesus authority over all people.
God gave this authority to Jesus.
Jesus can give eternal life to all the people God has given Him.
Jesus gives eternal life to these people.
passages.original: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ δώσῃ αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον

passages.text: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
passages.sermon:
Eternal life comes from knowing God.
God is the only true God.
God sent Jesus Christ.
Eternal life means knowing God and knowing Jesus Christ.
passages.original: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωὴ ἵνα γινώσκωσιν σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν Θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν

passages.text: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus said He glorified God on earth.
Jesus finished the work God gave Him to do.
God gave Jesus a specific work.
Jesus accomplished that work.
passages.original: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τὸ ἔργον τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω

passages.text: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Jesus asks the Father to glorify Him.
Jesus wants to be with the Father in His presence.
Jesus asks for the same glory He had with the Father before the world existed.
Jesus had this glory with the Father before creation.
passages.original: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ Πάτερ παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί

passages.text: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus revealed God's name to certain people.
God gave these people to Jesus.
God chose these people from the world.
These people belonged to God first.
God gave these people to Jesus.
These people have kept God's word.
passages.original: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ἔδωκας καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν

passages.text: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus said, "Now they know something important."
They know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
You gave Me all these things.
They understand that these things are from You.
passages.original: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα δέδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ εἰσιν

passages.text: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus said that God gave Him words.
Jesus gave these words to His followers.
The followers received the words.
The followers knew for certain that Jesus came from God.
The followers believed that God sent Jesus.
passages.original: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας

passages.text: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking.
Jesus prays for His disciples.
He does not pray for the world.
He prays for those whom God has given Him.
These people belong to God.
passages.original: Ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι ὅτι σοί εἰσιν

passages.text: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Everything I have belongs to You.
Everything You have belongs to Me.
I have been glorified in them.
passages.original: καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς

passages.text: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Jesus will soon leave the world.
The disciples will remain in the world.
Jesus is coming to the Father.
Jesus calls God "Holy Father."
Jesus asks the Father to protect the disciples.
Jesus asks the Father to use His name to protect them.
The Father gave His name to Jesus.
Jesus wants the disciples to be one.
Jesus wants them to be united, just as He and the Father are one.
passages.original: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι Πάτερ ἅγιε τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς

passages.text: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus was with His disciples.
Jesus protected His disciples.
Jesus used the Father's name to protect them.
The Father gave His name to Jesus.
Jesus kept the disciples safe.
None of the disciples were lost.
Only the son of destruction was lost.
This happened so that Scripture would be fulfilled.
passages.original: ὅτε ἤμην μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι καὶ ἐφύλαξα καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ

passages.text: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Jesus says He is coming to the Father now.
Jesus is still in the world as He speaks.
Jesus says these things while He is in the world.
Jesus wants His followers to have His joy.
Jesus wants His joy to be complete within them.
passages.original: Νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς

passages.text: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus gave God's word to His disciples.
The world hated the disciples.
The disciples do not belong to the world.
Jesus does not belong to the world.
passages.original: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου

passages.text: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Jesus is praying for His followers.
Jesus does not ask God to remove His followers from the world.
Jesus asks God to protect His followers from the evil one.
passages.original: Οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλ’ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ

passages.text: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks about His disciples.
Jesus says His disciples do not belong to the world.
Jesus Himself does not belong to the world.
The disciples are not of the world, just as Jesus is not of the world.
passages.original: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου

passages.text: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
passages.sermon:
Jesus prayed to God the Father.
Jesus asked God to sanctify His followers.
Jesus wanted God to make them holy.
Jesus said God should use the truth to sanctify them.
Jesus said God's word is truth.
passages.original: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν

passages.text: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
passages.sermon: Jesus is speaking to God the Father.\r\nGod the Father sent Jesus into the world.\r\nJesus also sent His followers into the world.
passages.original: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον

passages.text: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Jesus acts for the sake of His followers.
Jesus sets Himself apart for God's purpose.
Jesus does this for His followers.
Jesus wants His followers to be set apart.
Jesus wants them to be set apart by the truth.
passages.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν ἵνα ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ

passages.text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message, that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Jesus is praying for His disciples.
Jesus is not praying only for His disciples.
Jesus is also praying for people who will believe in Him.
These people will believe because of the disciples’ message.
Jesus asks that all believers will be one.
Jesus says, “Father, You are in Me.”
Jesus says, “I am in You.”
Jesus asks that all believers will be in the Father and in Him.
Jesus wants the world to believe that the Father sent Him.
passages.original: Οὐ περὶ τούτων δὲ ἐρωτῶ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων διὰ τοῦ λόγου αὐτῶν εἰς ἐμέ ἵνα πάντες ἓν ὦσιν καθὼς σύ πάτερ ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἡμῖν ὦσιν ἵνα ὁ κόσμος πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας

passages.text: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one— I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking to God the Father.
Jesus says, “You gave Me glory.”
I have given them the glory You gave Me.
I gave them this glory so they may be one.
I want them to be one just as We are one.
I am in them.
You are in Me.
I want them to be perfectly united.
I want the world to know that You sent Me.
I want the world to know that You loved them just as You loved Me.
passages.original: Κἀγὼ τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ἕν ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν ἵνα γινώσκῃ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἐμὲ ἠγάπησας

passages.text: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus called God "Father."
Jesus said, "Father, You have given certain people to Me."
Jesus said, "I want these people to be with Me."
Jesus said, "I want them to be where I am."
Jesus said, "I want them to see My glory."
Jesus said, "You gave Me this glory."
Jesus said, "You loved Me before the world began."
Jesus said, "You gave Me glory because You loved Me before the foundation of the world."
passages.original: Πάτερ ὃ δέδωκάς μοι θέλω ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἐμὴν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου

passages.text: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
passages.sermon:
God is the righteous Father.
The world does not know God.
Jesus knows God.
Jesus’ followers know that God sent Jesus.
passages.original: Πάτερ δίκαιε καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω ἐγὼ δέ σε ἔγνων καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας

passages.text: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to God the Father.
Jesus had made God's name known to His disciples.
Jesus would continue to make God's name known to them.
God loved Jesus.
Jesus wanted God's love for Him to be in His disciples.
Jesus wanted to be in His disciples.
passages.original: καὶ ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ γνωρίσω ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ἐν αὐτοῖς ᾖ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς
